Test Steps: Upload a clear non-expired passport image.
Expected Result: Document step passes and user can continue to active liveness.
Evidence To Capture: OCR/MRZ fields, expiry, quality score, fraud score, screenshot

Test Steps: Open camera, frame passport, capture image.
Expected Result: Document step passes with same fields as upload path.
Evidence To Capture: Captured image result, OCR/MRZ fields, decision payload

Precondition: Document type set to Lao ID card
Test Steps: Upload a clear non-expired Lao ID card.
Expected Result: Document step passes and expiry is parsed as future date.
Evidence To Capture: Name, DOB, expiry, ID number, quality score, screenshot

Precondition: Passport expiry is before test date
Test Steps: Upload expired passport.
Expected Result: Document is rejected with expired-document reason.

Precondition: Lao ID expiry is before test date
Test Steps: Upload expired Lao ID card.
Expected Result: Document is rejected with expired Lao ID reason.
Evidence To Capture: Decision payload and parsed expiry date

Test Steps: Upload animal, object, or random person image instead of ID.
Expected Result: Rejected as non-document upload.
Evidence To Capture: Reason code, fraud risk score, uploaded class

Test Steps: Upload a cat image as document evidence.
Expected Result: Rejected; cannot pass document step.
Evidence To Capture: Reason code such as NON_DOCUMENT_UPLOAD or DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND

Test Steps: Upload blurred passport image.
Expected Result: Rejected or manual review with blur/quality reason.
Evidence To Capture: Blur score, quality score, reason code

Test Steps: Upload dark passport image.
Expected Result: Rejected if fields unreadable; otherwise pass with acceptable OCR.

Test Steps: Upload glare-heavy passport image.
Expected Result: Rejected or manual review if important fields hidden.

Test Steps: Upload document where MRZ or key field is cropped out.
Expected Result: Rejected due to missing fields or poor document evidence.
Evidence To Capture: Reason code and OCR/MRZ extraction result

Test Steps: Upload rotated image.
Expected Result: System auto-corrects and passes or gives clear orientation rejection.

Test Steps: Upload screenshot instead of real capture.
Expected Result: Rejected or manual review as screen/copy risk.

Test Steps: Try uploading unsupported or unsafe file.
Expected Result: Rejected safely without backend crash.

Test Steps: Upload passport where the document portrait was edited.
Expected Result: Rejected or manual review with tamper/face-substitution signal.
Evidence To Capture: Fraud score, reason code, image class

Test Steps: Upload document with changed expiry date.
Expected Result: Rejected or manual review due to tamper or inconsistency.
Evidence To Capture: OCR date, MRZ date if any, mismatch reason

Test Steps: Upload document with edited visual passport number.
Expected Result: Rejected due to OCR/MRZ mismatch.
Evidence To Capture: Visual number, MRZ number, mismatch reason

Test Steps: Upload document with edited surname/given name.
Expected Result: Rejected or manual review due to name mismatch.
Evidence To Capture: OCR name, MRZ name, reason code

Precondition: Overlay text or fake stamp on document
Test Steps: Upload text-overlay document.
Expected Result: Rejected or manual review as edited document.

Test Steps: Upload document with cloned field region.
Expected Result: Rejected or manual review.

Test Steps: Upload passport with invalid MRZ checksum.
Expected Result: Rejected with MRZ invalid code.

Precondition: MRZ internally valid but visual text differs
Test Steps: Upload inconsistent document.
Expected Result: Rejected or manual review.

Test Steps: Upload synthetic passport template.
Expected Result: Rejected with high fraud risk.

Test Steps: Upload/capture printed copy image.
Expected Result: Rejected or manual review as copy risk.

Test Steps: Upload valid passport and compare extracted name to ground truth.
Expected Result: Full name matches expected normalized name.

Test Steps: Upload valid passport and compare number.
Expected Result: Passport number matches ground truth and MRZ.

Test Steps: Upload valid passport and compare DOB.
Expected Result: DOB parsed correctly in ISO format.

Test Steps: Upload valid passport and compare expiry.
Expected Result: Expiry parsed correctly and future/past evaluated correctly.

Test Steps: Upload valid passport and compare nationality.
Expected Result: Nationality code matches ground truth.

Test Steps: Upload Lao ID and compare name extraction.
Expected Result: Name extracted correctly or routed to manual review when confidence is weak.

Test Steps: Upload Lao ID and compare expiry.
Expected Result: Expiry date extracted and future/past evaluated correctly.

Test Steps: Upload Lao ID with difficult Lao script.
Expected Result: System extracts best effort fields or clearly marks manual review.
Evidence To Capture: OCR engine used, confidence, manual review reason

Test Steps: Click Face liveness before uploading document.
Expected Result: Blocked with message to upload accepted document first.

Test Steps: After rejection, click Face liveness.
Expected Result: Blocked; user must re-upload accepted document.

Test Steps: Click Gesture before completing active liveness.
Expected Result: Blocked.

Test Steps: Click Selfie before gesture completion.
Expected Result: Blocked.

Precondition: Gesture passed but selfie not completed
Test Steps: Click Result before selfie.
Expected Result: Blocked.

Test Steps: Refresh page and inspect session behavior.
Expected Result: State is restored safely or user restarts clearly without bypass.

Test Steps: Open camera and perform blink challenge.
Expected Result: Challenge auto-passes only after correct blink.

Test Steps: Perform open-mouth challenge.
Expected Result: Challenge auto-passes only after correct action.

Test Steps: Perform turn-left or turn-right challenge.
Expected Result: Challenge auto-passes only after correct movement.

Test Steps: Perform wrong action for challenge.
Expected Result: Does not pass until correct action is done.

Test Steps: Point camera at wall/background.
Expected Result: No pass; face absent message or waiting state.

Test Steps: Put two faces in frame.
Expected Result: Rejected or no pass due to multiple faces.

Test Steps: Show a phone screen video performing blink/head movement.
Expected Result: Rejected; screen/video replay cannot pass.

Test Steps: Show laptop screen video performing challenge.
Expected Result: Rejected.

Test Steps: Move printed face photo to imitate challenge.
Expected Result: Rejected.

Test Steps: Wear a mask and attempt active liveness.
Expected Result: Rejected or manual review if face is occluded.

Test Steps: Perform 3 requested gestures inside moving circle.
Expected Result: Gesture step passes.

Test Steps: Show wrong gesture.
Expected Result: Does not pass until correct gesture is shown.

Test Steps: Show correct sign outside random circle.
Expected Result: Does not pass until gesture is inside circle.

Test Steps: Keep camera on face/background only.
Expected Result: No pass.

Test Steps: Show printed hand gesture photo.
Expected Result: Rejected or manual review.

Test Steps: Show phone video of hand gestures.
Expected Result: Rejected or manual review.

Test Steps: Capture selfie of document owner.
Expected Result: Selfie passes passive liveness and face match.
Evidence To Capture: Face score, passive risk, selfie quality

Test Steps: Capture selfie of someone different from document portrait.
Expected Result: Rejected due to low face match.

Test Steps: Hold printed face photo in camera and capture selfie.
Expected Result: Rejected as spoof/photo replay.
Evidence To Capture: Passive spoof risk and reason code

Test Steps: Hold phone showing face photo/video and capture selfie.
Expected Result: Rejected as screen replay.

Test Steps: Show face on laptop monitor and capture selfie.
Expected Result: Rejected as screen replay.

Test Steps: Wear mask and capture selfie.
Expected Result: Rejected or manual review due to occlusion/low match.

Test Steps: Wear sunglasses and capture selfie.
Expected Result: Rejected or manual review if eyes/face quality insufficient.

Test Steps: Capture with another person or printed face visible.
Expected Result: Rejected due to multiple faces.

Test Steps: Capture non-human object or animal as selfie.
Expected Result: Rejected; no human face detected.

Test Steps: Move camera/person during capture.
Expected Result: Rejected due to selfie blur or low quality.

Test Steps: Capture selfie in dark lighting.
Expected Result: Rejected with clear guidance or pass only if confident.

Test Steps: Capture selfie with face turned away.
Expected Result: Rejected or manual review due to low match/pose.

Test Steps: Complete document, liveness, gesture, selfie.
Expected Result: One verified profile and one active face ID created.
Evidence To Capture: DB profile, user ID, face ID active flag

Test Steps: Try to verify same passport with a different user ID.
Expected Result: Rejected or linked to existing verified profile according to policy.

Test Steps: Enroll face again for same user.
Expected Result: Only one active face ID remains.
Evidence To Capture: DB record showing old face inactive/replaced

Test Steps: Use face login with enrolled user.
Expected Result: Login accepted and returns user profile.

Test Steps: Attempt face login with another person.
Expected Result: Login rejected.

Test Steps: Delete test profile/user ID.
Expected Result: Profile and active face ID removed or deactivated.

Test Steps: Open app from phone over HTTPS and start camera.
Expected Result: Camera permission works.

Test Steps: Open app via HTTP IP and try camera.
Expected Result: Camera blocked with clear warning.

Test Steps: Send request from unapproved origin.
Expected Result: Request blocked by CORS.

Test Steps: Upload image above limit.
Expected Result: Rejected safely without timeout/crash.

Test Steps: Upload corrupt image with image extension.
Expected Result: Rejected safely.

Test Steps: Submit many failed document/selfie attempts.
Expected Result: System throttles, blocks, or logs abuse.

Test Steps: Run one pass and one reject workflow.
Expected Result: Logs include decision, reason codes, timestamps, user/session ID.

Test Steps: Inspect stored profile fields.
Expected Result: Only verification result/profile fields needed by policy are stored.

Test Steps: Delete user/profile and verify storage cleanup.
Expected Result: Data removed or deactivated according to retention policy.

Test Steps: Start new signup and inspect consent/demo warning.
Expected Result: User sees consent/privacy/demo warning before sensitive upload.

Test Steps: Complete proofing and check email/SMS/in-app notification.
Expected Result: Proofing notification is sent or known gap documented.
